chunks: A number of our companions, from Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad, from ʿAlī ibn al-Ḥakam, from ʿAbd al-Raḥmān al-ʿArzamī, from Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:
There was between al-Ḥasan and al-Ḥusayn عليهما السلام one period of purity, and between them in birth there were six months and ten days.

key_terms.الْمِيلَادِ: birth; the time of being born
key_terms.طُهْرٌ: a period of purity between menstrual cycles

ai.seo_question: What was the age difference between Imam al-Ḥasan and Imam al-Ḥusayn عليهما السلام according to al-Kāfī?
ai.summary: This hadith reports the birth interval between Imam al-Ḥasan and Imam al-Ḥusayn عليهما السلام. It states that one period of purity separated them, and that the difference in their births was six months and ten days, preserving a biographical detail about the Ahl al-Bayt عليهم السلام.
